references.text: Jacob blessed his sons before his death, in the same way that Moses blessed the tribes of Israel before his death
Moses is called 'man of God' (ish ha-Elohim), the same title used here
Moses is called 'man of God' in the heading of this psalm
Describes Moses' death as the blessing was given before it
The Aaronic blessing that Moses conveyed to the children of Israel
Moses blessed the children of Israel after the tabernacle was completed
Jacob blessed Joseph's sons before his death, a similar pattern of blessing before death
